# ALLIN: Defense CC0 Audio Sources

Downloaded: 2026-08-16

All entries below were published under Creative Commons CC0 1.0 when downloaded. The legal code is stored beside this file as `CC0-1.0-Legal-Code.txt`.

## Sound effects

| Work | Creator | Project use | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| Interface Sounds | Kenney | UI, magic, state cues | https://kenney.nl/assets/interface-sounds |
| Impact Sounds | Kenney | combat, outpost and defeat impacts | https://www.kenney.nl/assets/impact-sounds |
| RPG Audio | Kenney | movement, weapons, building and economy | https://www.kenney.nl/assets/rpg-audio |

The original ZIP archives and their included license files are retained under `Kenney/`.
